sidebarTitle: Good music starts with an open mind.
sidebarText: Explore the catalog. Follow a name. Find something unexpected.
heroText: Take the scenic route through music. Explore songs, follow an artist’s name, and see where your curiosity takes you.
catalogIntro: A starting point, not a finish line.
catalogText: Real songs. Different corners of music. An open invitation to explore.
title: TITLE
searchText: A song title or an artist’s name is all it takes.
searchPlaceholder: Search for a song or artist…
artistSearchNote: Artist search finds songs matching the artist text in our catalog.
emptyText: No songs matched this search. Try a shorter title, another name, or browse the catalog.
emptyCatalog: The collection is quiet for now.
emptyCatalogText: No songs are available on this page. Browse the first page or try again later.
errorText: Check that the local API is running, then give it another try.
popularityNote: A score from the source dataset, not a live ranking.
noPlaybackText: This collection contains song metadata. Audio and album artwork aren’t included.
notFoundTitle: This page went off the record.
notFoundText: The page you’re looking for doesn’t exist. There’s still a whole catalog to explore.
songNotFound: That song isn’t in this collection.
songNotFoundText: It may be unavailable, or the link may have changed. Find another discovery in the catalog.
unexpectedText: Head back to the catalog and try again.
footer: A little less scrolling. A little more discovery.
